item.title: Kuji Chicken (Okukuji Shamo): Free-Range Flavour from the Mountains — Guide
item.description: Kuji chicken, more formally known as Okukuji Shamo, is a heritage chicken breed raised free-range in the mountainous Okukuji region of northern Ibaraki, prized for a firmer texture and richer flavour than mass-produced broiler chicken. The breed’s slower growth and active outdoor rearing produce meat favoured by chefs for yakitori skewers, hot pot and other preparations where the chicken’s distinct character can shine, and it appears in regional bento boxes sold at local train stations.
